title: Black nurses in the US Army Nurse Corps during the Second World War
description: Bar chart, nurses. The first quota, in 1940, was 56; the ceiling in 1943 was 160; 247 Black nurses were serving at the end of 1944, and 479 in September 1945, after the quota ended, in a corps of about 50,000. Data: Hine, as reported by JSTOR Daily (56 and 247), and Bellafaire, The Army Nurse Corps, US Army Center of Military History (160 and 479).
heading: BLACK NURSES IN THE ARMY NURSE CORPS
